task: AI-powered search engine for altermagnetic material discovery
named_methods: Self-supervised graph neural network pre-training via node masking
GINEConv (Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge features)
Laplacian positional encodings for symmetry awareness
pipeline_stages: 1. Load crystal graph data (pretrain: 5000 unlabeled, finetune: 2000 labeled, candidate: 1000)
2. Self-supervised pretraining: node feature masking and reconstruction
3. Supervised fine-tuning: binary classification with oversampling

model_architecture.encoder: 4-layer GINEConv with residual connections, layer normalization
model_architecture.classifier: 3-layer MLP with batch normalization, mean+max+sum pooling

key_assumptions: Crystal structure graphs encode sufficient information to distinguish altermagnets
Self-supervised pretraining on unlabeled data transfers to altermagnet classification
Class imbalance (5% positive) can be addressed via oversampling and focal loss
limitations: Node features are one-hot element encodings without explicit symmetry information
GNN may not capture global crystallographic symmetries
